mapper.insert: INSERT INTO g_user (USER_ID, USER_NAME, PASSWORD, NAME, USER_STATUS, ROLE, LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT, LOCK_TIME) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{name}, #{userStatus}, #{role}, #{loginFailCount}, #{lockTime})
mapper.select: SELECT u.*, s1.CODE_DESC as USER_STATUS_DESC, s2.CODE_DESC as ROLE_DESC FROM g_user u LEFT JOIN g_code s1 ON u.USER_STATUS = s1.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code s2 ON u.ROLE = s2.CODE_ID WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT u.*, s1.CODE_DESC as USER_STATUS_DESC, s2.CODE_DESC as ROLE_DESC FROM g_user u LEFT JOIN g_code s1 ON u.USER_STATUS = s1.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code s2 ON u.ROLE = s2.CODE_ID ORDER BY u.USER_ID
